title: Unable to use an IME on Android when using a physical keyboard
body: ### Tested versions - 4.x Bisect https://github.com/godotengine/godot/commit/55840c5d24b71206ad3b75d0bc8e4438eca537b9 Reproduced >= 4.1.2 - 3.x Bisect https://github.com/godotengine/godot/commit/55840c5d24b71206ad3b75d0bc8e4438eca537b9 Reproduced >= 3.6 ### System information Godot v4.8.dev (ca871ccc9) - Android 14 (SDK 34 build S.237425b-79ef) - Single-window, 1 monitor (2312x1080 @ 60.00 Hz) - Vulkan (Mobile) - integrated Mali-G57 MC2 - MT6833V/PNZA (8 threads) - Android (44100 Hz, Stereo/mono) ### Issue description Unable to use an IME on Android when using a physical keyboard. As a result, we can't type any characters that can only be composed through an IME. > Most users who use an external keyboard with an input method may not have noticed this issue, or don't know how to report it — so it only *looks* like nobody is affected. I believe this is an important issue. Note that this affects all text areas (including the editor). This is a regression introduced by: * https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/80932 * https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/80935 I fixed locally via removing all this ```diff - if (hasHardwareKeyboard()) { - return; - } ``` But it might lead (i have no samsung device, can't test) * https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/70751 I've also found an updated [message](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/70751#issuecomment-5035098865) saying you just need to disable `Predictive text`. However, I don't think we should simply _route key events directly to the engine_, as that makes the IME unusable. I believe this needs to be discussed. **Current** **Expected (4.1.1)** ### Steps to reproduce 1. Install IME (e.g. Gboard) 2. Switch IME to Gboard 3. Connect physical keyboard 4. Open godot and find a text area to type 5. no IME activated ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) N/A
